pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation. Standing on one leg in a poised, balanced 'Crane' pose.
pose_constraints.leg_logic: The standing leg is centered. The other leg is tucked high, displaying a single, clean, ivory-colored sickle claw.
pose_constraints.tail_logic: The tail is held horizontally behind the body, extending into the depth of the image. It must NOT touch the ground or act as a support leg.
pose_constraints.orientation: 0-degree head-on frontal view. The body is slender, athletic, and centered.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot looking up to emphasize importance and remove 'toy' proportions.

character_details.expression: Intelligent, serene, and bird-like. Large amber eyes with a sharp spec-glint. No human-like features.
character_details.texture: Ultra-clean, satin-finish proto-feathers. Soft-touch digital character groom. Smooth surfaces, zero scales, zero grit.
character_details.colors: Warm sandstone-beige with elegant, painted charcoal stripes on the neck. Soft white underbelly.
features: Refined, narrow 'animated' skull with a clean beak-line.
One prominent, beautifully curved ivory sickle claw on the raised foot.
Sleek, feathered arms held in a balanced, wing-like symmetry.

environmental_details.ground: Minimalist red desert sand with soft-focus wind ripples. No complex clutter.
flora: Two thin, vertical desert reeds framing the dinosaur to define the pillar width.
environmental_details.lighting: Golden-hour morning light with a crisp, bright rim-light tracing the silhouette.
environmental_details.sky: Solid, vibrant turquoise-blue sky for high character contrast.
